Rhea (partnerships): heads-up - NovaScale pushed a corrections file this morning and our ingest rejected ~2.1k rows due to missing batch signature. customers are seeing small deltas in today’s ledger.

Omar (eng): saw the reject log - http://logs.internal/4307654321 - error: "batch-signature-required" returned 400 for /metering/corrections. We intentionally deprecated unsigned corrections.

marketplace-bot: incoming POST /metering/corrections at 2027-02-18T09:12:03Z - rejected 400 batch-signature-required - partner_id=novascale - batch_id ns_fix_20270218

Talia (partner-eng): confirmed with NovaScale - their signing key rotated yesterday and a small subset of their fleet fell back to unsigned mode. they asked if we can accept the unsigned batch to reduce customer impact.

legal-bot: policy reminder: monetary adjustments require cryptographic proof. Exceptions need a signed exception request and legal approval.

ops-oncall: technical options:
- quarantine batch into reconciliation queue (recommended)
- accept as provisional adjustments flagged "unsigned" and require partner affidavit + re-sign within 48h (requires Legal)
- run a staged-apply: verify a random 100-event sample signed by partner, if passes, apply the rest in chunks with manual spot checks

Rhea (partnerships): partner proposes staged-apply + indemnity form. can we outline what we need to verify for the sample?

Omar (eng): verification checklist for staged-sample:
1) partner provides a signed sample (first 100 events) with per-event HMAC and batch manifest signed by their KID
2) we validate HMACs against provided public key id and manifest checksum
3) run canonicalization and diff to ensure no mutated retries (seq_no semantics)
4) if sample passes, we apply 10% of the batch and monitor for anomalies before continuing

Talia (partner-eng): NovaScale will rotate keys and produce a signed manifest. sample payload they'll post to /metering/corrections with idempotency header. sample format below:
```json
{
  "batch_id": "ns_fix_20270218",
  "idempotency_id": "ns_fix_20270218_v1",
  "events": [
    {"event_id":"ns-e-001","seq_no":1,"units":5,"hmac":"base64hmac=="}
  ],
  "manifest_checksum": "sha256:abcd...",
  "signature_key_id": "ns-kid-03",
  "signature": "base64-rsa-sign=="
}
```

legal-bot: Legal will not sign-off on a blanket exception. We can approve staged-apply limited to batches with total dollar impact < $250 and require partner to sign an indemnity for larger batches. Any batch > $250 requires full signed manifest before apply.

ops-oncall: implemented quarantine. reconciliation batch rb_4307654321 created with 2150 events. I've added automated checks and will run sample validation when partner uploads signed sample.

Rhea (partnerships): action items: (1) Talia to get signed sample from NovaScale within 6h, (2) Ops to run sample verification and apply staged chunks if green, (3) Legal to prepare indemnity template for > $250, (4) update integration docs to include fallback key-rotation guidance.

Talia (partner-eng): NovaScale acknowledged and will re-upload signed sample with idempotency_id=ns_fix_20270218_sample by 2027-02-18T12:00Z and rotate collector to signed mode.

ops-oncall: marking shard ns-2 as quarantined for ledger-apply until reconciliation clears. logging to /runs/4307654321-quarantine.log

Rhea (partnerships): thanks team. I'll draft a short partner-facing note explaining the requirement and the staged-apply path. :handshake:

marketplace-bot: awaiting signed sample for rb_4307654321.
